limitations: All captions55–59 read in full; no complete audiovisual audit or digitization of hidden board formulas
Whole-space Green integral requires suitable decay; bounded/periodic domains have different kernels/boundary terms and pressure gauge constraints
Homogeneous/constant-gradient route motivates local pressure models but does not determine nonlocal two-point correlations uniquely from one-point R
Rotta/IP equations are an illustrative closure family with source coefficient values, not every RSM or exact pressure response
Wall factor2.55 retained as lecture-specific; actual Foundation4.1 LRR wall normalization differs and is not silently mixed
Trace-free wall correction and PSD wall-function input do not prove full viscous-wall asymptotic consistency or global solution accuracy
Analytic periodic ensemble and homogeneous closure ODE are restricted executed tests, not new turbulent DNS, full spatial RSM or empirical validation
